name: lambda
title: Lambda (Batch + Real-Time)
description: Architecture blueprint that combines a batch path and a streaming path in one solution: historical data lands in a Lakehouse, live events flow through an Eventstream into an Eventhouse, and a Warehouse (or Gold layer) serves the unified view. Best when you need both up-to-the-second signals and reproducible historical analytics.
best_for: Workloads needing BOTH real-time event analytics and batch historical analytics, with a clear separation between the two processing modes.

item_set.purpose: Ingest live events into the Eventhouse
Batch transforms; reconcile hot/cold into serving layer
Real-time KQL analytics over the Eventhouse

decisions.guidance: Warehouse for T-SQL serving with multi-table transactions; Lakehouse Gold to stay all-Delta with Direct Lake.
Eventstream for routing/transforming multiple sources; direct KQL ingest for simple single-source streams.
KQL Dashboard for sub-minute live views; Report for modeled historical analysis.

build_with.deploy_ordering: Foundation storage (Lakehouse, Eventhouse, KQLDatabase, Warehouse) deploys before Eventstream and transforms; fabio deploy handles ordering.
outline: Create the cold path (lakehouse) and hot path (eventhouse + kql-database).
Create an eventstream and route live events into the KQL database (see workflow rti-pipeline).
Batch-ingest history into the lakehouse and transform via notebooks.
Create a serving warehouse; reconcile hot+cold; build a semantic model.
Add a Real-Time Dashboard (hot) and a Report (cold).
